_about: Supplier e-mails -> expected Signals for the reader's prompt tests. These 20 are WRITTEN BY HAND (no arena logs existed yet): #01 is the real reply from brief/api.md, the rest follow the patterns in data/correspondence (forward-bought energy, cash-short owners, pricing committees, free second shifts, price freezes ...). Replace / extend them with recorded e-mails: `python -m buyer.llm.review fixtures --out src/buyer/llm/tests/fixtures/recorded_emails.json`, then correct each `expected` by hand. Semantics: booleans and tone must match exactly; for lists every expected item must be present; `absent` items must not be.

message.subject: Re: HN volute casings - your letter of 11 September
message.body:
Guten Tag,
Your requested terms change our costs; our Angebot for them follows.
Preis €139.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 Tage netto, valid from 2027-04-01.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
Faster payment helps our cash flow; that is reflected in the price.
Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Price adjustment
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
thank you for your e-mail. We have checked the electricity index you cited. The figure is correct, but it is not our reality: we bought our electricity forward until December 2028 at fixed prices. Our price of EUR 141.20 stands.
Kind regards
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

message.subject: Re: Your proposal
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
we have reconsidered your proposal carefully. This is our final offer: EUR 136.90 per unit at 30 days net. We cannot go any further. Should you push further, we will have to end the negotiation.
Regards

message.subject: Re: Motor IE3 7.5 kW
message.body:
Thank you for your proposal. A price change of this size exceeds my authority; I have forwarded it to our pricing committee, which meets every two weeks. I will get back to you as soon as I have their decision. In the meantime our offer stands.
Best regards
Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

message.subject: Re: Shaft machining
message.body:
Good afternoon,
thank you for your request. Frankly, payment timing matters more to us than the last cent of price at the moment. If you could pay within 10 days, we could reconsider the price. Our bank is watching our figures closely.
Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

message.subject: Re: Turned parts
message.body:
Hello,
we would be glad to take on more parts from Hollerau. Our second shift has been on hold since spring and we have free machine capacity. With additional volume we could look at the price again.
Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

message.subject: Re: Bearing housing
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
our order intake is very strong and our foundry is fully booked until the second quarter. We can confirm additional volumes only against a binding 12-month commitment. Lead times have been extended to twelve weeks.
Regards

message.subject: Re: Seal kits
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
our price list applies to all customers without exception until December 2027. Head office has frozen all price changes this year. We are open to discussing logistics and payment conditions.
Kind regards

Dear Supplier Quality team,
we acknowledge the issues on the base frames. Please find attached our 8D report. We have introduced a full visual inspection before shipment. We regret the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
